name: Luminleaf Chronicles
detailed_description:
Enjoy a survival adventure defense roguelike game like never before!

“Luminleaf Chronicles” is a game that combines the survival/adventure/defense/roguelike genres that can be enjoyed alone or with up to four people. Acquire EPIC items, upgrade your skills, and fight against demons who want to destroy the World Tree at any cost in the sequentially generated in-game world!

Demons of the night who are afraid of the light
The demons must be captured during the day or else the stronger demons will destroy Lumicantl. At night, you must defeat powerful demons in the dark. As time passes, Kairos, the king of demons, grows closer to Lumicantl. As a cat girl, you must come up with a strategy to defeat Kairos.

Come up with a strategy!

Catch demons, acquire equipment, find forgotten knowledge, and upgrade your skills! Develop your own strategy and protect this world tree by catching increasingly powerful demons as quickly as possible!

Fight together!

Defeating Kairos requires solid judgment, focus, and great teamwork. We can rescue each other from danger! Survive until the end, defeat the boss together, and complete the achievement!

Fun of repeated play

With each new start, choose from a variety of characters, make the most of the items and upgrades you discover, and devise new strategies to defeat them quickly!
